requirements_summary: Target: enterprise chat+search for customer support and knowledge base reranking. Latency SLO: p95 < 300ms for 1-2 token granularity (short replies) and p95 < 700ms for long-form (<=1024 tokens). Throughput: steady-state baseline 40 QPS for chat agents, token budget ~4k tokens/sec steady, with expected peak bursts up to 200 QPS for 3-7 minutes during business spikes. Availability: 99.9% SLA desired for production route. Routing: prefer dedicated pool for EU region with automated fallback to hosted variants across regions. Data: EU residency, KMS-managed keys, audit logs for all requests, 30d retention windows for cached prompts. Security: SSO/SAML, SOC2 required, supply DPA. Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to commit to reserved capacity if unit cost reduces by ~30% vs on-demand.
